finding.problem: "I give him formula and a part of me grieves. Everyone acts like I quit. But he's fed, he's gaining, and I'm not crying at every feed anymore. Why does it still feel like shame?"
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (flagship) — "Fed Is Best, Mama: The Guilt-Free Mixed-Feeding Plan (breast + formula, shame-proof)." (anchors on Ogbonna "never an option not to BF," 51% medically unable – feminist analysis, Enugu 85% galactagogues.)". Verdict: PASSES (25/25)..
